saw_head: A subscription brand lives or dies on the second order.
saw_l1: Huel sells powdered meals, hot meals, drinks and bundles, and the whole site pushes the subscribe-and-save option. That is a customer base that is meant to come back every month.
saw_l2: Every subscriber who pauses, every one-time buyer who tried a bundle once and every cart that was left behind still sits in Klaviyo. Those lists are already paid for.
saw_turn: The segment reactivation system goes after exactly those people first: paused subscribers, one-time buyers and abandoned carts, with flows and campaigns built around the next order, not the first one.
audit_tail: For Huel that starts with paused and cancelled subscribers.
